notes.title: Ver 0.6.1.0 is released!
notes.content:
We've added a bunch of new Battle Cheats to our Summer Sale!
Use the new battle cheats to defeat your enemies more strategically!
We have also made changes to the UI to make it easier to play!
We believe that adding more Battle Cheats will make the game much more fun! We have completed creating the groundwork for more battle cheats and will be adding more as needed, enjoy!

[h3]SYSTEM UPDATE[/h3]
Shot prediction line accuracy has been improved to support battle cheats.

[h3]BATTLE CHEAT[/h3]
Added 7 types of battle cheats

[h3]BALANCE[/h3]
Fixed unlocked items at player level
Corrected initially unlocked battle cheat contents

We're a little late to the party, but Bit Oz is also getting a major update just in time for Black Friday!

At the same time, we are having a sale! Please take this opportunity to play!

notes.title: v0.52 released!
notes.content:
Hello! How is everyone doing in this hot summer?
As we announced the other day, we have made a V0.52 update of Bit Oz Wonder Crusher.

The fixes are as follows

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
Fixed a bug that after restarting the game, the statuses increased by the normal patch returned to their default values
Fixed an issue where Attack Compile looks like a jabber cube
Fixed effects of attack compilation
Fixed an issue where the patch to increase the HP limit was not functioning properly
Fixed an issue where the text for the Early version at the end of World 1 was greatly out of place in the English version
Fixed an issue with world exercises being skipped under certain conditions
Fixed an issue where the battle cheat cheat description was not displayed correctly
Fixed an issue where enemy bomb shots would get stuck on walls
Fixed a bug that prevented movement to some squares in World 1
Fixed a bug where enemies would not drop Bit

[h2]SYSTEM UPDATE[/h2]
Updated battle maps for treasure chest squares.

[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
Speeded up the bullet speed of Fuld's normal shot
Adjusted the amount of Bit that drops

[h2]OTHER[/h2]
Changed World 1 battle background

We are planning a major update to add World 2 with minor updates in the future.
Please look forward to it!

notes.title: April 15: Early Access begins!
notes.content:
This is short notice, but the Early Access will start on Saturday, April 15 at 10 AM!

Bit Oz Wonder Crusher is a game that is still in production, but we have decided to release it as an Early Access version for now.

There are many reasons for this, but we want to be the first to let you play the game and reflect your feedback in the game.
We invite you to experience playing this "aim and shoot" shooting rogue light game and let us know what you think!

[h1]Regarding the current Early Access version[/h1].

[h2]Differences between the Early Access version and the full version[/h2].
The Early Access version has a different amount of content compared to the full version, including the worlds you can play. The detailed differences will be explained in the following sections.
Products purchased in Early Access can be updated to the full version without any changes. The price may be increased when the full version is released.

[h2]Elements currently playable in the Early Access version[/h2].

[h3]Main game (Dive To CyberEden)[/h3].
This is the main content of the game, which can be entered from the icon on the home screen
Currently only [b]World 1[/b] is playable ([i]Less, sorry! [/i])
In the full version, it will be possible to play up to 3 worlds.

Player level will increase when the EXP you get from clearing the main game and game over reaches a certain value. This will increase the number of battle cheats, patches, and Oz updates you get during gameplay.

[h3]Oz Update[/h3].
This system allows players to attach Oz Updates obtained from player level increases to their characters, increasing their initial stats at the start of the game and giving them special abilities.
We plan to add a new system called Repro Gacha in the future, which will also allow players to acquire Oz Update from this system!

[h2]Elements to be implemented in future updates[/h2].
[h3]New battle cheats, patches, worlds, enemies and bosses (short span)[/h3].
We plan to further enhance the systems that are currently playable.
We are thinking about increasing the volume of the game, as well as unique battle cheats, object skills, powerful enemies, hidden root bosses (not sure if this can be done), etc.
We hope to update this one as soon as we can realize our idea.

[h3]Repro Gacha[/h3].
This is a system where you can select packs and randomly obtain various in-game elements, decorations, and other items.
This can be used by consuming "ant scores" obtained after playing the main game.
This is intended to make playing Bit Oz a long and enjoyable experience, as new packs may appear depending on the conditions achieved through gameplay.

[h3]Enhancement of the production aspect[/h3].
We do not find the current effects and presentation of Bit Oz satisfactory.
We want to make the characters more animated and appealing, cool effects to double the fun of the game, enemy appearances, interesting objects, stage backgrounds, etc., all better.

There are many more things we would like to tell you about, but that's all for now.
There are a lot of bugs in Early Access, and this is our first time releasing a game on Steam, so we may cause some inconvenience to our players.
In that case, please contact us and we will do our best to respond.
